subject: Issues in browsers for app hosted on glimmer

messages.author: 972e2ef0c27b2b6b
messages.subject: Issues in browsers for app hosted on glimmer
parts:
Hi,

I am having an issue with an application that is hosted on glimmer (http://glimmer.rstudio.com/andeek/DevNetworkGraph/). I am using input bindings to have the D3 chart call an R function on drag in the window, which then updates a table. This functionality used to work perfectly fine, but as of the last few months the table has stopped being updated and I see no new errors in the console. When I run the application from the glimmer server using runApp() everything works perfectly. Do you have any ideas what may have cause this? I've checked with Chrome and Firefox browsers.

Thanks,
Andee

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Issues in browsers for app hosted on glimmer
parts:
I see an error in Chrome when selecting the nodes:

Uncaught ReferenceError: shiftKey is not defined

which points to

https://github.com/andeek/Community-Detection/blob/master/Prototype%20D3-Shiny/Network%20Graph/scripts/graph_2.js#L114

and it turns out to be a typo... You defined shiftkey instead of shiftKey.

Regards,
Yihui
